species.description: ids separated by commas; empty : a few animals on four legs and on two

radius.description: of the turns, in lengths of the animal

speed.description: times the speed of the clip

gait.description: walk, trot or run : the clip the walk is made from

gap.description: metres between the paths of two animals

follow.description: n : the camera goes round the n-th animal

procedural.description: false : the clip as it is, feet sliding through the turns

stride.description: length of the steps against the clip's

step_height.description: how high the feet are lifted against the clip

clearance.description: metres the feet are lifted over the ground at least

soft_depth.description: metres the feet sink in the ground

exit_vertical.description: 0 : the feet leave soft ground along their swing, 1 : straight up first

bend.description: how much the body follows the curve of its path
